written.headline: Anthropic targets up to $90.4B in IPO and private placement
written.summary: Anthropic's IPO is approximately 7x oversubscribed as the company and its backers seek to raise up to $90.4 billion via an IPO and private placement. The AI firm is targeting a fully diluted valuation of approximately $1.4 trillion.

written.headline: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round for AI sensors
written.summary: Indian semiconductor startup Bharat Semi has raised $24 million in seed funding to develop AI-enabled image sensors and target commercial production in 2027. The pre-revenue company has secured design wins with General Atomics and Kaynes Semicon.

written.headline: Nvidia considers leadership options after Jensen Huang's departure
written.summary: Nvidia's board approached Arm Holdings CEO Rene Haas as a potential successor following Jensen Huang's resignation. CFO Colette Kress is currently serving as interim CEO.

written.headline: Huawei's Horinger AI data center has ~7% of Colossus 2 compute
written.summary: Epoch AI analysis shows Huawei's Horinger data center holds about 7% of the computing power of xAI's Colossus 2 campus. Horinger is estimated to have roughly 81,000 H100-equivalent units of compute compared to Colossus 2's 1,112,000 units.
